note: rect_pt / pivots_pt: pt inside the frame, origin top-left; layers back -> front (z); every layer shares the full render's camera, so drawing each at rect_pt recomposes the full render; overlay layers and non-default group members are swapped in by the animation

layers.name: drum
layers.note: the bounce drum: the hop (translateY -5 pt) + the live count on its tag

layers.name: clouds
layers.note: the clouds in front of the drum's foot: a small drift

baked: default layers carry the full render's colour where they are top-most (cast shadows included)
